name: netscoot
description: The netscoot plugin: AI-agent skills for restructuring .NET, PowerShell, Unity, and native C++ projects.

plugins.name: netscoot
plugins.description: A safer way for your agent to restructure .NET, PowerShell, Unity, and native C++ projects. netscoot uses each format's own tooling where one exists, otherwise changes only the paths, and rolls back if a step fails, instead of the agent hand-editing solution and project files.
